title: The Toy Box
intro: [whispers] Shhh, Andy's gone. [excited] Welcome in to Disney Jeopardy, toy box edition! Tonight it is cowboys, space rangers, piggy banks and puppets. When the humans leave the room... the trivia comes to LIFE.

art.prompt: A giant open wooden toy chest in a sunny kid's bedroom spilling out toys: a cowboy hat, a toy rocket, building blocks, a wind-up robot and a piggy bank, cloud wallpaper. Wide 16:9 composition, original painterly animated-film style artwork, no text, no logos, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

categories.title: You've Got a Friend in Me
categories.intro: We start with the film that started it all for Pixar. It is Toy Story. Reach for the sky, partner.

art.prompt: A child's bedroom with blue cloud wallpaper, a cowboy hat on a bed, a toy rocket on a shelf, a pull-string toy box, warm afternoon light. Wide 16:9 composition, original painterly animated-film style artwork, no text, no logos, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

clues.clue: Woody's high-flying rival is this space ranger who thinks he can fly.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Buzz Lightyear. That is not flying. That is falling, with style.

clues.clue: Woody, Buzz and the gang belong to this boy, who writes his name on their boots.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Andy. Woody spends the whole first movie worried about being replaced. [laughs] Relatable.

clues.clue: Buzz meets a crowd of three-eyed squeaky aliens at this rocket-themed restaurant.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is... Pizza Planet. And that Pizza Planet truck shows up in almost every Pixar movie. Keep your eyes peeled.

clues.clue: The aliens inside the claw machine worship this, saying it chooses who will go and who will stay.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Claw. [high-pitched] Ooooooh. You saved our lives. We are eternally grateful.

clues.clue: In Toy Story 2, toy collector Al of Al's Toy Barn has this last name.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is McWhiggin. Al McWhiggin, the chicken-suited TV pitchman. Only TRUE toy nerds had that one.

categories.title: Toys Will Be Toys
categories.intro: [excited] Our next category is about toys outside of Toy Story. Puppets, stuffed bears, arcade games, the whole toy chest.

art.prompt: A woodcarver's workshop full of handmade toys: wooden puppets on strings, cuckoo clocks, a stuffed teddy bear and a tin one-man-band toy. Wide 16:9 composition, original painterly animated-film style artwork, no text, no logos, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

clues.clue: Geppetto carves this wooden puppet who dreams of becoming a real boy.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Pinocchio. Just don't ask him if he likes your trivia skills. Watch the nose.

clues.clue: Winnie the Pooh and his friends are stuffed animals belonging to this boy.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Christopher Robin. The Hundred Acre Wood was based on a real forest in England. [laughs] Bring honey.

clues.clue: Wreck-It Ralph is the bad guy in this arcade game, but the hero gets all the pies.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is... Fix-It Felix Jr. Thirty years of getting thrown off a building. Ralph deserves that medal.

clues.clue: This 1988 Pixar short about a one-man-band toy fleeing a baby was the first computer-animated film to win an Oscar.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Tin Toy, starring a toy named Tinny. It inspired Toy Story. [shudders] That baby still gives me nightmares.

clues.clue: Annette Funicello played Mary Contrary in this 1961 Disney live-action musical about a toy-filled land.
choices: The Nutcracker and the Four Realms
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Babes in Toyland, with Ray Bolger as the villain Barnaby. Yes, the Scarecrow from Oz played a bad guy.

categories.title: Alpha-Bet You Can't
categories.intro: [mischievously] Time for Alphabetize This. I will describe three toys. Figure out who they are, then put their names in alphabetical order.

art.prompt: Colorful wooden alphabet blocks stacked in a tumbling tower on a playroom rug, a few toys peeking from behind. Wide 16:9 composition, original painterly animated-film style artwork, no text, no logos, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

clues.clue: Alphabetize these toys: the cowboy, the piggy bank, the dinosaur.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Hamm, Rex, Woody. H, R, W. Even a T. rex with tiny arms can count to three.

clues.clue: Alphabetize these toys: the cowgirl, the space ranger, the horse.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Bullseye, Buzz, Jessie. Bul beats Buz, so the horse wins by a nose. [laughs] Giddy up!

clues.clue: Alphabetize these toys: the spork, the pink bear that smells like strawberries, the Canadian stunt rider.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is... Duke Caboom, Forky, Lotso. D, F, L. Lotso still smells great, even in last place.

clues.clue: Alphabetize these toys: the penguin with a broken squeaker, the porcelain shepherdess, the coiled-spring dachshund.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Bo Peep, Slinky Dog, Wheezy. [chuckles] Wheezy got his squeaker fixed and sang You've Got a Friend in Me. Legend.

clues.clue: Alphabetize these toys: Buzz's evil emperor arch-enemy, the Woody's Roundup prospector, the 1950s pull-string doll with a broken voice box.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Gabby Gabby, Stinky Pete, Zurg. Call him the Prospector and it still works. G, P, Z. Villains in order, how tidy.

categories.title: Playtime in the Parks
categories.intro: Now we shrink down to toy size and visit the parks. [chuckles] This category is called Playtime in the Parks.

art.prompt: A theme park land built at toy scale: giant building blocks, oversized crayons and a roller coaster track that looks like a bendy toy, blue sky. Wide 16:9 composition, original painterly animated-film style artwork, no text, no logos, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

clues.clue: In Toy Story Land you can zoom around a roller coaster themed to this springy pup.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Slinky Dog, on Slinky Dog Dash. Andy built that coaster himself, according to the story. Talented kid.

clues.clue: Toy Story Land is found in this Walt Disney World park.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Disney's Hollywood Studios. You are shrunk down to the size of a toy in Andy's backyard. [laughs] Watch out for the sprinkler.

clues.clue: This Toy Story Land quick-service spot serves grilled cheese and totchos from a giant lunch box.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is... Woody's Lunch Box. Order the totchos. Trust me. Your diet can start in the 800 round.

clues.clue: To play the carnival games on Toy Story Mania!, guests must wear these.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is 3D glasses. [chuckles] You fire virtual darts and pies at the screen. It is the only place pie throwing is encouraged.

clues.clue: Toy Story Land opened at Walt Disney World in this year.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is 2018, on June 30th. Slinky Dog Dash and Alien Swirling Saucers both opened that day.

categories.title: Who's Pulling the String?
categories.intro: The Club DJ members chose voice actors. I name the toy, you name the star who voices it. Reach for the sky!

art.prompt: A pull-string with a ring dangling from a toy's back against a backstage recording studio with microphones and headphones, playful lighting. Wide 16:9 composition, original painterly animated-film style artwork, no text, no logos, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

clues.clue: This two-time Oscar winner voices Sheriff Woody.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Tom Hanks. His brother Jim Hanks voices Woody for a lot of the toys and video games.

clues.clue: To infinity and beyond! This comedian voices Buzz Lightyear in the main Toy Story films.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Tim Allen. Chris Evans voiced the movie Buzz in the 2022 film Lightyear. [laughs] Different Buzz, same buzz.

clues.clue: The Matrix star Keanu Reeves voices this Canadian stuntman toy in Toy Story 4.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is... Duke Caboom, Canada's greatest stuntman. Yes, Keanu. You're breathtaking.

clues.clue: Yodel-ay-hee-hoo! Joan Cusack voices this cowgirl.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Jessie. When She Loved Me still makes grown adults cry. [sniffles] Grab a tissue.

clues.clue: Ned Beatty voices this huggable villain in Toy Story 3.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Lots-o'-Huggin' Bear. Smells like strawberries, runs Sunnyside Daycare like a prison. Classic.
